title: LEAP 2025: Life Skills on Deck
description: LEAP 2025: Life Skills on Deck is an exciting, challenge-based event where participants take on the role of stranded survivors who must use everyday life skills to complete survival tasks. From repairing clothes and applying first aid to tying knots and mastering other essential life skills, participants will test their real-world problem-solving abilities through fun, hands-on activities. This event offers a thrilling and practical way to sharpen everyday skills while building connections and making new friends under pressure.
venue: Henry Sy Building 4th Floor, Verdure Hall

title: LEAP 2025: Disc-Connected
description: Catch your breath and throw your worries to the wind. Disc-Connected invites students to unwind and grab the thrill of ultimate frisbee. This free play tournament is all about connection--through teamwork, friendly competition, and feel-good moments.
venue: Enrique M. Razon Sports Center, Floor 7A

title: LEAP 2025: 3, 2, 1, Block Blast!
description: LEAP 2025: 3,2,1, Block Blast! will be a two-hour video game competition centered around the popular game Block Blast. The event will begin with a group stage, where players will be divided into five groups of ten. Each participant will compete against every other player in their group, and based on their performance, the top six and bottom four players from each group will advance to the upper and lower brackets, respectively.

title: LEAP 2025: Git Hired: From Repos to Resumes
description: LEAP 2025: Git Hired: From Repos to Resumes is an event that aims to prepare students with necessary skills to be able to explore the computer science job market deeper. With the help of guest speakers in the CS field, the event seeks to offer guidance on the internship application process, portfolio-making, and resume-building.

title: LEAP 2025: The Power of Public Speaking
description: LEAP 2025: The Power of Public Speaking is a dynamic seminar-workshop designed to help participants build confidence, think on their feet, and communicate effectively. Led by esteemed speaker and DLSU professor Mr. George Marchan, the session includes a keynote talk, an extemporaneous speaking exercise with feedback, and other exciting challenges. This class offers a supportive space for Lasallians to sharpen their public speaking skills and express themselves with clarity and impact.

title: LEAP 2025: Roast by the Coast: Cozy Brews, Ocean Views (AM)
description: Step into a world where flavors dance and every cup holds a touch of magic. In Roast by the Coast, embark on a whimsical journey through the art, science, and stories behind coffee—from the roots of the bean to the final, fragrant pour. Awaken your senses, spark your creativity, and discover the wonder hidden in every sip.

title: LEAP 2025: Palette and Plaster: Bond in Every Brushstroke
description: LEAP 2025: Palette and Plaster: Bond in Every Brushstroke features a beginner-friendly plaster painting session, offering participants the creative freedom to design and paint their crafts in their own unique style. Set in a relaxed and inclusive environment, the activity encourages imaginative expression while fostering meaningful connections among attendees. The event aims to promote creativity and social engagement through a shared artistic experience.

title: LEAP 2025: Comedy Manila: Magic Meets Mic
description: This class is a stand-up comedy show featuring guest performers from the local scene, designed exclusively for the university audience. This engaging event offers students a break from their academic routines by providing an evening of humor and lighthearted entertainment. Guests will perform their sets and show various comedic styles that will enrich the participants' experience and gain insight on how to keep an audience engaged while conveying an impactful message through laughter and jokes.

title: LEAP 2025: Discover Your Circle of People
description: LEAP 2025: Discover Your Circle of People is an interactive networking mixer event that brings together individuals with shared interests and hobbies. Through team-building activities, group challenges, and casual conversations within their assigned "circles," participants are encouraged to build meaningful connections, meet like-minded people, and form new friendships. The event fosters a genuine sense of belonging - making everyone feel seen, heard, and part of something bigger.
venue: Bro. Andrew Gonzales Hall – 20th Floor Multipurpose Room

title: LEAP 2025: Beads of Connection
description: Interested LEAP participants are invited to a hands-on Bead Bracelet Making Workshop to inspire creativity and self-expression. The workshop will offer guidance through various techniques, making it suitable for beginners and those looking to refine their craft. By the end of the workshop, each attendee will take home their handmade bead bracelets and a new set of creative skills.

title: LEAP 2025: Fire the Lasers! A Pirate's Take on Tech
description: Set sail into the world of innovation with this hands-on CNC etching workshop! Students will learn how to use laser engraving technology to turn digital designs into custom creations. Channeling the spirit of high-tech treasure hunters, participants will navigate tools of precision and creativity to etch their mark.

title: LEAP 2025: From Beads to Bonds
description: This LEAP class is a creative and collaborative space where students can engage with Bukluran ng mga Manggagawang Masigasig sa Kaunlaran Inc. (BMMK), a community organization dedicated to empowerment through livelihood. It will allow BMMK to share their own stories through a seminar and allow the students to learn from them through a jewelry-making workshop. This class bridges advocacy and artistry, showing how everyday creativity can carry deeper meaning.

title: LEAP 2025: Mix n Matcha
description: Mix n Matcha is a hands-on matcha-making workshop designed to offer students a calm, culturally enriching break from the pressures of university life. Participants will learn the art and cultural history behind matcha while creating their own drinks in a relaxing, guided environment. The session encourages mindfulness, creativity, and meaningful interaction within the Lasallian community.

title: LEAP 2025 - PalAUrong Pinoy: A LEAP Back in Time
description: LEAP 2025: PalAUrong Pinoy - A LEAP Back in Time is a fun-filled event that celebrates classic Filipino street games to promote connection, friendly competition, and physical wellness among students. The event encourages participants to leap back in time and reconnect once again with the Filipino culture. The games are structured to encourage teamwork and strategy, providing a nostalgic break from academic stress.

title: Leap 2025: Sit Still, Look Pretty!
description: LEAP 2025: Sit Still, Look Pretty! allows students to enter the world of portrait photography, where every click and light tells a story. Discover the craft and technique behind capturing beauty with intention-- mastering composition, lighting, and camera settings. With Addy's creative dust, students will learn and enhance their photography skills and unlock the power of visual storytelling through portraits.

title: LEAP 2025: Steering AI Through Storms of Integrity
description: Artificial Intelligence is one of the most cutting edge technologies that change the way we think and learn about the world, but there are a multitude of ways this tool, if used incorrectly or without thought, can rob us of valuable growth and learning opportunities. LEAP 2025: Steering AI Through Storms of Integrity will help students navigate these challenges in order that students know the responsible use of AI particularly in the context of academic integrity. This LEAP class will tackle the ethical use of AI in academic settings, especially in the context of the Lasallian Community.

title: LEAP 2025: File Named: Hired_Resume_Final(FINAL).pdf
description: Your resume is more than just a list of experiences—it’s a reflection of your growth, goals, and potential. In this workshop, you’ll learn how to transform your academic, organizational, and personal accomplishments into a clear and compelling resume through guided discussions and real-world examples. Whether you're applying for internships, leadership roles, or your first job, this session will help you showcase your strengths with confidence.

title: LEAP 2025: In Between the Lines and Notes
description: "LEAP 2025: In Between the Lines and Notes" is a seminar which delves into the intricate relationship between Literature and Music. From musical icons like The Beatles, Taylor Swift, and more, the class explores how literary themes, narratives, and poetic devices have become an essential tool for songwriting and its perspectives across various genres. Through the discussions of the invited speaker, attendees will gain a deeper appreciation of how rhythm, tone, and storytelling converge to enrich both literature and music.

title: LEAP 2025: Expanding Horizons Leveraging Tech-powered Productivity
description: This workshop will teach students and young professionals how to maximize workspace applications like Google Sheets and Notion. Participants will explore practical ways to integrate automation into these tools. The class will focus on tailoring workflows for greater efficiency and productivity.

title: LEAP 2025: Board with Sputnik: Destination Neverland (Onsite)
description: Sputnik is an aviation recreation center that offers seminars and hands-on flight simulations led by pilots and safety experts. The session introduces students to emergency response, crisis management, and basic safety protocols. Through interactive activities, participants will gain practical skills, situational awareness, and confidence in handling real-life scenarios.
venue: Henry Sy Sr. Hall 5th Floor, Jose T. Pardo AFSC Hall

title: LEAP 2025: Pearlescent Skies: A Taste of The Future
description: Our class is a creative and reflective journey where participants explore their personal dreams through movement, storytelling, and teamwork. Guided by the calming energy of the "Coral Lagoon," we connect individual aspirations with global goals using the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as inspiration. It's a space for self-discovery, imagination, and meaningful conversations about identity, well-being, and purpose.

title: LEAP 2025: Just DAUnce: Empower Through Every Move
description: LEAP 2025: Just DAUnce: Empower Through Every Move is a workshop designed to promote physical wellness among students through the fun and engaging medium of dance. By learning popular choreographies, participants of Just DAUnce are encouraged to stay active, relieve stress, and build coordination. This event also fosters connection and community by blending physical activity with fun and creative dance routines.

title: LEAP 2025: Board with Sputnik: Destination Neverland (Off-Campus)
description: Sputnik is an aviation recreation center that offers seminars and hands-on flight simulations led by pilots and safety experts. The session introduces students to emergency response, crisis management, and basic safety protocols. Through interactive activities, participants will gain practical skills, situational awareness, and confidence in handling real-life scenarios.
venue: 2/F Sparta Commune, 126 Pioneer Street, Mandaluyong, Philippines

title: LEAP 2025: Scoop of Magic
description: LEAP 2025: A Scoop of Magic is an engaging and hands-on workshop that offers students the opportunity to create their own ice cream from scratch in a fun and relaxed setting. Designed to encourage creativity, collaboration and beating the heat, the session will guide participants through a step-by-step process using simple, accessible ingredients—no specialized equipment required. This activity aims to provide a refreshing and enjoyable break from academic life, fostering meaningful connections and shared experiences through the joy of making and enjoying homemade ice cream.

title: LEAP 2025: Escape the Pirate's Watch
description: Step into the enchanted world of Adventure Land, where imagination knows no limit and challenges await at every turn. LEAP 2025: Escape the Pirate's Watch inspires students to think critically and collaborate as they navigate a captivating digital escape room and uncover the secrets hidden within Hollowtree Hideaway. This experience ignites students’ curiosity, encouraging them to see beyond the visible and trust in possibilities that have yet to be discovered.

title: LEAP 2025: Linked by Thread: A Celebration of Friendship
description: LEAP 2025: Linked by Thread: A Celebration of Friendship is a two-hour workshop where participants get to design and create personalized friendship bracelets with their friends. Each table will have a dedicated facilitator who will guide the group through the step-by-step bracelet-making process, offering tips, support, and creative suggestions along the way. Overall, participants are given full creative freedom to choose their own patterns and colors, making each bracelet a unique keepsake that represents the bond they share with someone special.

title: LEAP 2025: Anchored in Hope: Building a Drug-Free Lasallian Community
description: LEAP 2025: Anchored in Hope: Building a Drug-Free Lasallian Community is a face-to-face seminar that sheds light on the realities of drug abuse and empowers Lasallians to take a stand through empathy and informed advocacy. This event aims to inspire participants to become proactive champions of a drug-free and and learning about the university’s support systems to build a safe, informed, and compassionate Lasallian community.

title: LEAP 2025: Reverie
description: This activity offers participants a chance to showcase their vocal talents and enjoy music in a supportive, judgment-free environment. It encourages self-confidence, emotional expression, and active participation. By singing together, participants build stronger social connections.

title: LEAP 2025: Whispering Keepsakes
description: LEAP 2025: Whispering Keepsakes is a writing workshop that invites writers to imagine and unlock untold stories held within mundane objects. The class will be divided into groups, choose 1 - 2 items from the random keepsake of the Lost Boys, and create either a one-page poem or flash fiction under 500 words. This event challenges them to see objects not just as things but as vessels of meaning and untold tales.

title: LEAP 2025: Tech Treasures: Exploring Your Passion in Tech
description: LEAP 2025: Tech Treasures: Exploring Your Passion in Tech is an event where professionals from different tech backgrounds share their various career journeys. Attendees are given opportunities to network with professionals, create meaningful connections with other participants, and cultivate better career-related insights through hands-on activities.

title: LEAP 2025: Clay-tastic Creations with JRex
description: Participants will be given various colors of air-dry clay and will engage in a hands-on workshop where they will learn basic sculpting techniques and create their personalized clay crafts. The activity will include a short demonstration, guided practice, and a showcase of finished pieces.

title: LEAP 2025: Glimmer Grove: A Diamond Painting Workshop
description: This face-to-face workshop provides an opportunity for participants to learn diamond painting. Following a tutorial video on how to diamond paint, the participants would create their own artworks based on prepared designs prior to the class, which are based on nature and magical elements such as forests and sea, and wizards and fairies, respectively. Through this, the LEAP class would allow the participants to explore their creativity through painting and form connections with other participants who share a similar interest in the arts.

title: LEAP 2025: Adventureland's Song: Weave the Music Tunes into the Sky
description: "This class aims to create a heartwarming space for students to relax, connect, and express themselves through karaoke music. Whether they're a seasoned vocalist or simply looking to unwind after academic work, students will be able to celebrate each other's performances and embrace the joy of music. This session encourages students to let go of stress and find comfort in shared moments, fostering a sense of community by building meaningful bonds together.		"

title: LEAP 2025: Tales Told Through Visuals
description: LEAP 2025: Tales Told Through Visuals is a photography workshop that explores the art of visual storytelling and crafting compelling narratives using imagery. From understanding the principles of composition and color to mastering the emotional impact of visual elements, the workshops aims to convey powerful stories without words. Participants will be able to analyze visual narratives across various medium, experiment with different storytelling techniques, and develop their unique style and voice as visual storytellers.

title: LEAP 2025: Roast by the Coast: Cozy Brews, Ocean Views (PM)
description: Step into a world where flavors dance and every cup holds a touch of magic. In Roast by the Coast, embark on a whimsical journey through the art, science, and stories behind coffee—from the roots of the bean to the final, fragrant pour. Awaken your senses, spark your creativity, and discover the wonder hidden in every sip.

title: LEAP 2025: Symphonic Adventures: An evening with the Manila Symphony Orchestra
description: This event brings a one of a kind orchestra experience with Asia's oldest orchestra to the Lasallian community. Symphonic Adventures: An Evening with the Manila Symphony Orchestra is an orchestra concert where songs of fantasy, magic, and adventure will be performed at the Teresa Yuchengco Auditorium. This concert is a portal to a night of songs that are magical and fantastical, using instruments played by one of the most recognized orchestra in Asia.

title: LEAP 2025: Skybound Strokes: Painting a World Without Limits
description: LEAP 2025: Skybound Strokes: Painting a World Without Limits invites students to a magical paint-by-numbers session. Surrounded by the enchanting world of Adventureland, participants will create whimsical skybound designs that celebrate freedom, flight, and limitless possibility. This relaxing, creative experience offers a joyful escape where imagination knows no bounds.

title: LEAP 2025: Your Star Map to Event Magic
description: This workshop introduces key principles of event planning, focusing on conceptualization, resource management, and audience engagement. It provides practical training to enhance participants' event planning skills, ensuring successful execution. Designed for aspiring student leaders, the workshop equips them with the tools and confidence to create impactful campus events.

title: LEAP 2025: Sail aCROSS the WORlD
description: LEAP 2025: Sail aCROSS the WORlD is an interactive, team-based crossword challenge where teams will race against each other to complete the puzzle. There will be rounds wherein teams who finished the crossword puzzles stay until the last team standing wins. This activity enhances collaboration, teamwork and communication between members in order to solve the puzzle set out for each team.

title: LEAP 2025: Seven Seas Swap Party
description: The Seven Seas Swap Party is ready for you to give away treasures to a new friend for only 200 pesos! There are two main events: The Swap Party includes swapping clothes, bags, and accessory items. There will also be a talk with Ms. Cheris, where participants will listen and learn more about how to be a sustainable shopper in a world of maximalism and consumerism.

title: LEAP 2025: Remembering Us
description: LEAP 2025: Remembering Us is a writing workshop that offers a safe place and imaginative creativity, making the writers look back, and allow them to write entries about a childhood memory that sticks to them. Writers would be split into equal groups, having to collaborate on a poem or prose piece about a childhood-related memory or object. Overall, the organization seeks to let the participants explore their childhood memories, inspiring them out the nostalgia of those times.

title: LEAP 2025: SquiDIPLOMATIC Games
description: This LEAP class is inspired by the TV show ‘Squid Game’ wherein participants will be playing a series of minigames. The SquiDIPLOMATIC Game aims to showcase diversity through popular childhood games from different cultures around the world, consisting of individual and team games promoting strategic thinking, teamwork, and collaboration.

title: LEAP 2025: PixSEA Flavors: A Cold Dessert Journey Through Southeast Asia
description: LEAP 2025: PixSEA Flavors: A Cold Dessert Journey Through Southeast Asia class aims to be a platform to offer students to explore Southeast Asian culture through Southeast Asian culinary or cuisine. In this class, students will be able to learn about different desserts in Southeast Asia and be able to do it themselves or immerse themselves with the culture. All desserts are cold desserts and purely mixing of ingredients, alike to mixture of diversity in Southeast Asia.

title: LEAP 2025: Where Lost Boys Take Aim
description: To the place “Where Lost Boys Take Aim,” where imagination meets precision! Inspired by the fearless spirit of Adventureland, Green Archers are invited to discover the thrill of archery and learn how to steady their hands, sharpen their focus, and build their consistency both on and off the range. This session showcases and teaches the foundational techniques required to enter the world of archery, encompassing challenges that stimulate excitement and good sportsmanship among aspiring archers.

title: LEAP 2025: Where Lost Boys Take Aim
description: To the place “Where Lost Boys Take Aim,” where imagination meets precision! Inspired by the fearless spirit of Adventureland, Green Archers are invited to discover the thrill of archery and learn how to steady their hands, sharpen their focus, and build their consistency both on and off the range. This session showcases and teaches the foundational techniques required to enter the world of archery, encompassing challenges that stimulate excitement and good sportsmanship among aspiring archers.

title: LEAP 2025: Think Business, Pitch Smart
description: This leap class is an online seminar designed to help participants build a strong business mindset, and confidence in pitching their ideas. It focuses on surpassing mental hurdles and developing practical strategies to think like an entrepreneur, communicate purposefully and sell ideas effectively.

title: LEAP 2025: Color Fantasia
description: Unleash your inner artist in EATF’s LEAP 2025: Color Fantasia digital paint-by-numbers workshop designed to make creativity more accessible. This asynchronous class will tackle on how to color using accessible graphic design software through a coloring book style experience, helping you explore tools and techniques at your own pace, whether you're a beginner or just curious, this class brings creativity and tech together in a fun, easy-to-follow format. This will help people gain creative confidence and also learn on graphic design software that is freely available.

title: LEAP 2025: LEAP into Law: A Pixiefied Perspective
description: LEAP 2025: LEAP into Law: A Pixiefied Perspective is a film-showing class featuring Bar Boys, a coming-of-age story that follows the journey of four friends as they navigate the challenges of law school in the Philippines. Through its portrayal of academic pressure, family dynamics, personal sacrifice, and ethical dilemmas, the film offers an engaging look into the realities of pursuing a legal career. This session aims to provide students with a deeper understanding of the law school experience while encouraging reflection on the values of perseverance, integrity, and friendship within the context of legal education.

title: LEAP 2025: Sail aCROSS the WORlD
description: LEAP 2025: Sail aCROSS the WORlD is an interactive, team-based crossword challenge where teams will race against each other to complete the puzzle. There will be rounds wherein teams who finished the crossword puzzles stay until the last team standing wins. This activity enhances collaboration, teamwork and communication between members in order to solve the puzzle set out for each team.

description: This leap class is an online seminar designed to help participants build a strong business mindset, and confidence in pitching their ideas. It focuses on surpassing mental hurdles and developing practical strategies to think like an entrepreneur, communicate purposefully and sell ideas effectively.

description: This leap class is an online seminar designed to help participants build a strong business mindset, and confidence in pitching their ideas. It focuses on surpassing mental hurdles and developing practical strategies to think like an entrepreneur, communicate purposefully and sell ideas effectively.

title: LEAP 2025: Where Lost Boys Take Aim
description: To the place “Where Lost Boys Take Aim,” where imagination meets precision! Inspired by the fearless spirit of Adventureland, Green Archers are invited to discover the thrill of archery and learn how to steady their hands, sharpen their focus, and build their consistency both on and off the range. This session showcases and teaches the foundational techniques required to enter the world of archery, encompassing challenges that stimulate excitement and good sportsmanship among aspiring archers.

title: LEAP 2025: BinGLOW GO GO!
description: LEAP2025: BinGLOW GO GO! is a structured bingo game session designed to foster excitement, engagement, and friendly competition among participants. Each player will receive an individual bingo card and race to complete a specified pattern—whether a line, a shape, or a full blackout—as numbers are drawn at random across multiple rounds. The activity promotes attentiveness, quick thinking, and camaraderie in a relaxed and enjoyable environment.

title: LEAP 2025: Thesis It! Film Viewing
description: Spearheaded by Team Communication, LEAP 2025: Thesis It! Film Viewing is a showcase of previous thesis documentaries, films, and short series produced by Communication alumni or soon-to-be graduates. Recognizing the creativity and originality of students and serving as an avenue of raising awareness on various issues in current society, Thesis It! puts emphasis on the intersection of art and communication in finding solutions for the improvement of society, country, and world through a communicative standpoint.

title: LEAP 2025: ATM: Adulting Talks on Money
description: ATM: Auditing Talks on Money is a practical personal finance workshop that caters to young adults. Essentially, it covers hands-on topics like budgeting, saving, investing, and utilizing fintech tools, all presented through the personal experiences and knowledge of fintech professionals.

title: LEAP 2025: Pixiebeats & the Magical Mixes
description: LEAP 2025: Pixiebeats & the Magical Mixes introduces students to the fundamentals of DJ-ing. It covers rhythm management, smooth transitions, and crafting a unique musical style across genres. Designed for beginners, the class offers a solid foundation in DJ culture and live performance.

title: LEAP 2025: Treehouse Tricks and Fairy Flicks
description: LEAP 2025: Treehouse Tricks and Fairy Flicks, invites students into a world of artistic freedom, self-expression, and art therapy. Through creative projects and whimsical board games, students ignite their imaginations and explore their inner worlds. The class nurtures both playfulness and personal growth in a supportive and interactive, magical environment.

title: LEAP 2025: Feuding in the Hollowtree
description: Feuding in the Hollowtree is a Family Feud-inspired LEAP Class aiming to promote collaboration, communication, and quick thinking among students, while also being a way for them to relax and enjoy. Made specifically for Lasallians, the game incorporates relatable and relevant prompts that explore the students' experiences and interests. Through this activity, students can bond with their peers, enhance their engagement, and have a refreshing break from routine academic lessons.

title: LEAP 2025: Rank up!
description: LEAP 2025: Rank Up offers Lasallians an exclusive look into the competitive gaming industry through insights from two esteemed experts. This class provides a unique opportunity to explore the inner workings of the esports scene, broadening career possibilities while inspiring students to pursue their dreams with dedication, just like the speakers themselves.

title: LEAP 2025: Me? Forget? Never. A Test through Time
description: "LEAP 2025: Me? Forget? Never. A Test through Time is a quiz bee that will test students' knowledge on different fields of history such as Philippine history, world history, current events, and general knowledge. Amidst the proliferation of misinformation, the quiz bee paves the way to encourage students on being aware and informed on the presence and relevance of knowing different historical knowledge and information that are present throughout the various periods of history, whether it be in the Philippines or the world. Furthermore, the attendees would have this opportunity to interact with one another as they navigate their shared interest in this discipline."

title: LEAP 2025: Leaf It To Us!
description: In an immersive session with two guest speakers, the participants will be primed on the relevance of climate action and the intricacies of plant care. Each person will inherit a succulent to nurture as their own to apply the insights gained from the class. This class aims to push Lasallians to take a small but meaningful step into a greener future, so when it comes to making a difference, you can Leaf it to Us!

title: LEAP 2025: Navigating Adventureland: A Delicate Dance of Choice and Chance
description: LEAP 2025: Navigating Adventureland: A Delicate Dance of Choice and Chance is a face-to-face and industry specific event focused on applied probability, with elements of combinatorics and game theory. Participants—solo or in groups—will navigate a series of math-based games designed to simulate the journey to Adventureland. Each game presents real-world-inspired challenges that require strategic decision-making and probabilistic reasoning.

title: LEAP 2025: Weaving Wonders: From Threads to Transformation
description: Through a hands-on crochet session, participants are introduced to Nomana, a purpose-driven social enterprise, while learning about its mission, values, and impact. The class fosters a deeper appreciation for artisan craft and highlights how creative pursuits can support community-based enterprises and social change.

title: LEAP 2025: Counting Gold from Bead to Bead
description: LEAP 2025: Counting Gold from Bead to Bead is a hands-on event dedicated to enhancing students’ mental math skills using a counting tool derived from the ancient Chinese suanpan, known as the Soroban Abacus. This event can be done through making their own DIY abacus and learning how to quickly count with the fundamental arithmetic operations. With this, students will be able to strengthen their memory of place values and number patterns, and at the same time, will be able to explore the cultural perspective to appreciate the significance of this centuries-old tool in modern learning environments.

title: LEAP 2025: Reel Reflections
description: LEAP 2025: Reel Reflections will feature a screening of PROMISES, an emmy award winning documentary about the completely different lives of children who, geographically, live only 20 minutes away from each other. This documentary highlights the huge disparity between the two countries’ quality of life, living standards, and rules they are subjected to. Additionally this is highly relevant to the current situation in Gaza strip that aims to spread awareness to the conditions that the Palestinian people have been subjected to for half a century. Through cinema and dialogue, it creates an area for the audience to be socially aware and socially empathetic Lasallian students who carry forward the true values of a LaSallian education.

title: LEAP 2025: Into Adventureland’s Medical Adventures (PM)
description: LEAP 2025: Into Adventureland's Medical Adventures is a medical/science Film Viewing event for people who love medical films and dramas! It will feature interactive activities about the films and includes different prizes as well. Come and join us in this medical adventure!

title: LEAP 2025: Into Adventureland’s Medical Adventures (AM)
description: LEAP 2025: Into Adventureland's Medical Adventures is a medical/science Film Viewing event for people who love medical films and dramas! It will feature interactive activities about the films and includes different prizes as well. Come and join us in this medical adventure!

title: LEAP 2025: The Break-even Club: Career Insights – Investment Edition
description: The Break-even Club: Career Insights --Investment Edition aims to help participants refine their knowledge regarding investment roles through the advice shared by industry experts. The industry experts will share the daily responsibilities and required skills to thrive in the industry.

title: LEAP 2025: Riding the Wave: A Dive into Procrastination
description: The seminar focuses on the topic of procrastination and the factors behind it. With Sir. Zapanta, a Psychologist, as our speaker, the class aims to provide facts and information on the psychological factors that affect the act of procrastination as well as providing science-backed tips and tricks on how to cope with Procrastination

title: LEAP 2025: Data Science for Dummies
description: LEAP 2025: Data Science for Dummies is your gateway to unlocking the power of data - no coding background needed. This beginner-friendly class breaks down complex concepts into simple, practical lessons led by an expert speaker. Walk away with new skills and a certificate to boost your portfolio and future-ready confidence

title: LEAP 2025: Fairy Jump: Chinese Garter Competition
description: LEAP 2025: Fairy Jump: Chinese Garter Competition will be a Chinese Garter Competition where there are 8 teams composed of 5 members, where they compete in a traditional Filipino game, Chinese Garter. The class aims students to be introduced or reintroduce to Chinese Garter and they will be challenged at their creative skills on how to get over the garter while also exercising their sportsmanship and their teamwork, alongside their teammates.

title: LEAP 2025: Let's Catch That Flag!
description: LEAP 2025: Let's Catch That Flag! is the Information Security Organization's annual flagship event where Lasallians race against time - and other participants - to solve various cybersecurity challenges and capture ""flags"" or hidden codes within those puzzles. A brief introduction to CTFs shall be held before the participants sail through the competition, tackling beginner to intermediate level obstacles in a face-to-face environment. At the end of the competition, the team with the most points shall be crowned the winner.

title: LEAP 2025: Drabbling Danmei, Blurbing Baihe, and Other Oneshots
description: LEAP 2025: Drabbling Danmei, Blurbing Baihe, and Other Oneshots is a class whose intention is focused on crafting drabbles—short, 100-word stories—inspired by danmei and baihe, genres rooted in Chinese queer literature. This class invites participants to explore themes of intimacy, identity, and resistance through concise storytelling, while also engaging in critical discussions on representation, cultural context, and genre conventions, so as they write and revise their drabbles, they’ll sharpen their critical thinking by analyzing how narrative choices reflect broader social and historical frameworks. Finally, this class also emphasizes research as a creative tool, encouraging participants to delve into the cultural origins and evolution of danmei and baihe to inform and enhance the depth of their writing.

title: LEAP 2025: AMTales Trivia Challenge
description: LEAP 2025: AMTales Trivia Challenge is an interactive, team-based trivia showdown where participants will compete through multiple themed rounds that test their wit, memory, and teamwork. Designed to spark both fun and friendly competition, this activity encourages collaboration, critical thinking, and effective communication as teams race to earn the top score and emerge victorious.

title: LEAP 2025: Tinker, Tailor, Lawyer, Write: Crafting Arguments that Fly
description: Tinker, Tailor, Lawyer, Write: Crafting Arguments That Fly is a LEAP class featuring a legal writing workshop designed to engage aspiring lawyers and writers. By inviting industry professionals, fostering collaboration among like-minded participants, and offering valuable resources, the event emphasizes the importance of developing persuasive writing skills through hands-on experience.
slug: LEAP 2025: Tinker, Tailor, Lawyer, Write: Crafting Arguments that Fly

title: LEAP 2025: Tales in Color
description: LEAP 2025: Tales in Color will take students to the world of fantasy, testing both their creativity and knowledge of the supernatural and magical. Through interactive coloring sessions followed by a trivia game where students will be divided into groups, this class seeks to nurture critical thinking, artistry, and teamwork. By bringing color to imaginative figures and engaging in a lively challenge of wits, the students will be offered a day of fun and relaxation while stimulating their social and cognitive skills.

title: LEAP 2025: POLIkula - The Feminine Rebellion
description: This class event will feature the docu-drama film "The Feminister", it will be a 90-minute workshop that combines a screening of the 2018 documentary on Swedish Foreign Minister Margot Wallström with interactive political discussions and creative expression activities. Through visual storytelling, documentary analysis, and expressive dialogue, participants explore Wallström's feminist foreign policy and her resistance to traditional diplomatic norms. Mirroring Peter Pan's defiance of adult conventions, the event highlights how outsider perspectives and idealism can drive meaningful change.

title: LEAP 2025: Curtain Call for Change
description: LEAP 2025: Curtain Call for Change is an engaging seminar-meets-runway event exploring the intersection of fashion, creativity, and sustainability. Industry minds will share insights on design careers and sustainable practices, while participants are challenged to turn a simple everyday item into stylish creations. The experience, aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goal 12, ends with a mini-fashion show celebrating conscious, innovative fashion, proving that conscious fashion can still turn heads.

title: LEAP 2025: Safe Spaces and Pages
description: The class is a workshop that teaches participants the benefits of integrating journaling into their daily lives. The workshop teaches how journaling can be used as an essential tool used to improve one's well-being and get to know themselves better. The workshop also aims for participants to relax by exploring their creative side.

title: LEAP 2025: Dance into the Night Away in AJALand
description: LEAP 2025: Dance the Night Away in AJALand - is a Dance Workshop, designed for participants who wish to try and learn how to dance. The participants can run through the final choreography and showcase the learned choreography, and even showcase their dancing skills through a little bit of Random Play Dance that highlights the choreography learned and dance to the latest dance trends.
venue: Br. Andrew Gonzales Hall, 20th Multipurpose Hall

title: LEAP 2025: Aperture Unlocked: Photography for Change
description: Aperture Unlocked is a creative photography workshop that empowers participants to become advocates through visual storytelling. Inspired by UNICEF’s mission, the session guides participants in capturing compelling images that reflect pressing social issues, ranging from children’s rights, education, and health, to environmental impacts and animal welfare. Through a short talk, a guided photo walk, and a reflection session, students will explore how photography can raise awareness, spark empathy, and inspire action. This hands-on experience encourages participants to use their creativity for a cause, turning powerful visuals into tools for advocacy and change.

title: LEAP 2025: Eco-Emotions: Engaging with Environmental Psychology
description: LEAP 2025: Eco-Emotions: Engaging in Environmental Psychology is an event that explores the emotional and psychological impacts of climate and environmental issues on individuals and communities. This event will discuss how these eco-emotions emerge, how they affect behavior and health, and how we can respond in healthy, empowering ways. Through the lens of environmental psychology, participants will gain tools to better understand and manage their emotional experiences in a rapidly changing world.

title: LEAP 2025: UNITED in Adventureland: A Sensory Toy Workshop
description: Step into Pixie Hollow and uncover the magic of sensory play with UNITED through an exciting workshop that begins with a brief talk on how sensory toys spark curiosity, creativity, and self-expression. Students will then engage in hands-on toy-making, crafting items like squishy sensory bags, stress balls, and sound shakers to showcase their unique artistic ideas. By the end of the session, they can choose to either take home their creations or donate them through UNITED to benefit children in need at the St. La Salle Preschool.

title: LEAP 2025: Hydraulic MESchines
description: Hydraulic MESchines is a strategic and practical skills class hosted by the Mechanical Engineering Society (MES) of De La Salle University. This workshop aims to familiarize the participants with the basic concepts of hydraulics and its significance through a hands-on activity—the creation of a simple hydraulic arm.

title: LEAP 2025: Cosmic Command -- Navigating the Gravity of Leadership
description: As each individual traverses a new path in their journey, leadership may feel like an inescapable aspect, whose gravity brings upon a brand new pull. However, this simply opens another universe of opportunities that help broaden each one’s horizons even more. With a series of activities, this session will help ultimately hone each person's leadership skills and empower them through the spirit of volunteerism and service.

title: LEAP 2025: Mastering Leadership in a Sea of Change
description: LEAP 2025: Mastering Leadership in a Sea of Change promises to be an interactive and productive seminar-workshop to develop a skill essential in everyday life: leadership. In this class, students will hear from distinguished speakers to absorb practical tips and tricks in being a leader for others and for oneself. The main event for this class is a group-based activity wherein you will take essential leadership skills, such as compromise, innovation, and communication, to your advantage as participants accomplish varying multi-stage scenarios.

title: LEAP 2025: A Slime-Filled Journey to the Heart of Stella Verde
description: LEAP 2025: A Slime-Filled Journey to the Heart of Stella Verde is a whimsical slime-making workshop where participants journey to the fairy nook to save Town Stella Verde (Green Stars) from falling apart. Along the way, they face magical scenes that mirror real-life societal issues, with each challenge solved through creative slime-based tasks. Through this adventure, students express their emotions freely—turning colors and textures into meaningful creations that reflect both their inner world and the world around them.
venue: St. La Salle Hall L230, Tereso Lara Seminar Room

title: LEAP 2025: Fairy Dust & Feminist Trust
description: The class is a pajama party-themed session centered on feminism, designed to create a relaxed and welcoming space for open dialogue, games, and shared experiences. Led by Angel Veridiano, known as notangel on YouTube, the session will feature activities like the GForms Fishball, where participants can anonymously share their encounters with gender inequality to spark deeper conversations. Through candid storytelling, audience participation, and interactive elements, the session aims to make feminist discourse more accessible, engaging, and relatable for all.

title: LEAP 2025: Shoot That Shot
description: LEAP 2025: Shoot That Shot is a content creation workshop designed to equip students with the basics of creating engaging and meaningful social media and video content.Participants will learn about storytelling, authenticity, and navigating the digital space through an interactive session with an invited speaker. Whether just starting out or finally ready to post that draft, this class is a safe space to explore content without the cringe.

title: LEAP 2025: JeoPHYrdy
description: Get ready to spark your competitive spirit! This LEAP Class is a Jeopardy-style showdown, where teams will compete across a dynamic board of categories ranging from Physics and all things DLSU, to wild-card topics and general knowledge. Strategy, speed, and smarts are your keys to victory.

title: LEAP 2025: From Earth to Easel
description: LEAP 2025: From the Earth to the Easel: The Chemistry of Pigments is an interactive workshop that dives into the vibrant world of paint pigments. Accompanied by knowledge tidbits on the history of pigments, the relaxing painting session allows students to discover how chemistry has influenced art through the millennia. This immersive approach transforms normally abstract concepts into more tangible, digestible experiences, therefore making the art of science more accessible to the masses.

title: LEAP 2025: Plan Before You Fly: Financial Literacy for Dreamers
description: Money talks — and it’s time you learned to speak its language. LEAP 2025: Plan Before You Fly is a 2-hour online crash course on budgeting, debt management, and financial support tools designed for students like you. With interactive games, a personal vision board activity, and key insights from expert guest speakers on government financial programs and smart money habits, you’ll walk away ready to take control of your financial future.

title: LEAP 2025: Synergy Games
description: Synergy GaMES is an adventure-based activity designed to foster camaraderie through classic Filipino childhood games such as Jackstones and Pinoy Henyo. More than individual skills, these challenges emphasize teamwork, communication, trust, and adaptability to successfully fulfill the goal of each task. Participants are encouraged to reconnect with their playful side while building stronger bonds in a fun and nostalgic environment.

title: LEAP 2025: Tales From The Hollow
description: LEAP 2025: Tales from the Hollow is an asynchronous film viewing activity designed to bring students together for a day of inspiration, imagination, and reflection. Set against the enchanting backdrop of Fairy Nook, this LEAP class invites participants to slow down, reconnect with their inner child, and rediscover the beauty of creativity and possibility through the critically acclaimed animated film, Howl's Moving Castle by Studio Ghibli. The purpose of this event is to foster a space where minds, creatives, and dreamers alike can gather - not just to enjoy a film, but to reflect on the values that Howl's Moving Castle so powerfully conveys: the courage to change, the power of compassion, and the magic found in moving forward, even when the path seems uncertain.

title: LEAP 2025: Tetris Tournament
description: LEAP 2025: Tetris Tournament is a fast-paced, fun-filled competition that brings students together through the classic game of strategy and speed. Open to all skill levels, the tournament encourages quick thinking, problem-solving, and friendly competition. More than just winning, it offers a chance to connect, unwind, and enjoy a uniquely nostalgic LEAP experience.

title: LEAP 2025: AniCharm
description: This pottery workshop offers hands-on experience in shaping, molding, and glazing clay. Participants will learn basic air dry clay techniques, including  hand-building, while creating their own unique charm pieces. The class is suitable for beginners and provides a relaxed, creative environment for exploring the art of clay.

title: LEAP 2025: Survey Says! Trivia Wars
description: "Survey Says! Trivia Wars" is a fast-paced and highly interactive LEAP class where Lasallians go head-to-head in teams, guessing the most popular answers to a wide range of survey-based trivia questions. Inspired by the Family Feud format, the class blends pop culture, general knowledge, and DLSU-specific trivia to create an engaging and light-hearted competition. Every participant is actively involved, making the experience both inclusive and impactful.

title: LEAP 2025: Embassy Talk: Study Abroad Forum
description: Thinking about studying abroad? Get insider tips from embassy officials on scholarships, top schools, and how to make your move. Take the first step toward an education that takes you places.

title: LEAP 2025: Living Book Talks: From Faith to Action: DLSU's Commitment to Human Rights and Social Justice (Onsite)
description: Living Book Talks is a storytelling platform for sharing personal narratives and successes about gender, religion, belief, race, life aspirations, political affiliation, disability, or profession. This program highlights that, like any book, each person has a unique and compelling story or lesson to impart to their readers. The collaboration aims to highlight the library’s thrust in supporting the university’s mission to provide safe and inclusive spaces for everyone
venue: Chill @ the 5th, 5/F, The Learning Commons, Henry Sy, Sr. Hall

title: LEAP 2025: Living Book Talks: From Faith to Action: DLSU's Commitment to Human Rights and Social Justice (Online)
description: Living Book Talks is a storytelling platform for sharing personal narratives and successes about gender, religion, belief, race, life aspirations, political affiliation, disability, or profession. This program highlights that, like any book, each person has a unique and compelling story or lesson to impart to their readers. The collaboration aims to highlight the library’s thrust in supporting the university’s mission to provide safe and inclusive spaces for everyone.

title: LEAP 2025: Self-defense at the Coral Lagoon
description: LEAP 2025: Self-defense in the Coral Lagoon is a one-day introductory workshop on Judo basics, designed to equip participants with practical self-defense skill. Through partner-based activities, students will learn foundational Judo techniques such as breakfalls, throws, and holds in a safe and supportive environment.

title: LEAP 2025: Glow like a Pro: Makeup Workshop
description: This Makeup Workshop aims to teach the students how to effectively apply their makeup and enhance their makeup skills. This activity will show and teach the students the power of makeup—and how it can help in boosting one's confidence and present themselves better.

title: LEAP 2025: Into the World of Fairy Nook
description: LEAP 2025: Into the World of Fairy Nook is an online event that invites students to take a break from academic stress and recharge. Through light and engaging games like OpenGuesser, Foono, and 8 Ball Pool, participants can enjoy friendly competition and reconnect with their playful side. The event promotes the value of rest and wellness in a fun, meaningful way.

title: LEAP 2025: Are You DTF? Dont Tone Fail!
description: Don't Tone Fail is workshop tailored for today's teens and young adults, especially those hailing from Filipino-Chinese backgrounds and are eager to reconnect with their roots. Instead of redoing those old textbook drills, we're diving into the colorful schene of Chinese street slang — because let's face it, that's where all the real-time conversations happen. By blending trendy, social media-inspired expressions into everyday vocabulary, we're going down a road to make Chinese culture into hor something more relatable, relevant, and collaborative!

title: LEAP 2025: The World Beyond
description: LEAP 2025: The World Beyond explores student exchanges that could be presented as opportunities to people. In this LEAP class we would want to showcase the "World Beyond" by cross-cultural understanding, going on exchange, and the growth that it gives them. Exploring the world with a cause and purpose.

title: LEAP 2025: Moments of Mindfulness
description: LEAP 2025: Moments of Mindfulness is an event that will feature a known clinical psychologist and national social scientist to discuss how practicing mindfulness can enhance emotional regulation. This will feature interactive activities and discussions that can help students improve and cope in the different facets of their well-being.

title: LEAP 2025: BUKASyon
description: LEAP 2025: BUKASyon is an interactive and reflective class designed to deepen students' understanding of vocation as a holistic response to God's call. Through intimate dialogues with individuals living diverse vocations, participants will gain authentic insights into the joys and challenges of discerning one's life path. This class goes beyond traditional career discussions, encouraging students to explore their personal calling within the framework of faith, service, and communion in mission.

title: LEAP 2025: Culture X
description: Feel the rhythm of the world through live performances of music, dance, and fashion. Each act brings a new culture to life right before your eyes. This is global celebration at its most vibrant.
venue: Corazon Aquino Democratic Space (CADS), Henry Sy Sr. Hall Grounds

title: LEAP 2025: ArcherGO: Go Green, Let's Bingo
description: "ArcherGO: Go Green, Let's Bingo! is a one-day event that brings the Lasallian community together through a fun and engaging game of Bingo. Held on June 20, 2024, at the Henry Sy Sr. Hall Grounds, this fundraising event supports the University Vision-Mission Week 2024 beneficiaries. Participants will enjoy meaningful interaction while contributing to a greater cause.  Bingo Card Price: ₱100 for 2 cards (₱80 for additional card)"

title: LEAP 2025: Boto Mo, Kinabukasan Mo
description: The event will feature a local film viewing of the 2024 movie, Balota, a powerful and timely Filipino film that explores the complexities of the electoral process in the Philippines. The film is especially relevant to the students in Development Studies as it sheds light on issues such as political participation, voter empowerment, and the challenges of democracy in grassroots communities.
